profile.label: Profile
profile.hint: Each profile has its own extensions, with their own data. Everything below is about the profile chosen here.

list.label: Your extensions
list.hint: The switch puts an extension into the sidebar, above your tabs. Chromium's own “Pin” on its extensions page works too.
list.hint_of: The switch puts an extension into the sidebar, above your tabs, in the spaces of {profile}. Chromium's own “Pin” on its extensions page works too.

elsewhere.label: In your other profiles
elsewhere.hint: Not installed in {profile}. An extension is installed profile by profile: “Add” opens its page in the Chrome Web Store, in a tab that runs in {profile}, where you confirm it.

manage.label: Install and manage
manage.hint_of: Installing, removing, turning off and site access live on Chromium's pages. They open in a tab that runs in {profile}.
manage.hint_shared: Removing, turning off and site access live on Chromium's extensions page. All your spaces use the main profile, so they share these extensions.
manage.hint: Removing, turning off and site access live on Chromium's extensions page.
